independence_model: Each generated value is one independently initiated campaign-level unit. Field use additionally requires manifest validation and must account for shared site, weather, gateway, and provider shocks.

scenarios.name: safe_modest_20ms
scenarios.interpretation: Candidate is never slower and has a 20-ms campaign-level benefit.

scenarios.name: safe_strong_80ms
scenarios.interpretation: Candidate is never slower and has an 80-ms campaign-level benefit.

scenarios.name: unsafe_20ms
scenarios.interpretation: Candidate is 20 ms slower and can convert QoS successes into misses.

interpretation: Admission probability is conditional on the stated synthetic data-generating process. The 721-group analytical floor is necessary for best-case non-vacuity but is not sufficient for useful power. A disjoint field pilot must replace these assumptions before deployment.
